mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility falls from an elevated level, people are spending more time outside home and shifting activity into out-of-home destinations, which should lift RETAIL_REC within two weeks and keep it above the prior four-week mean.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 6.1 to 4.4 over the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below +5 from an elevated reading.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility falls sharply while WORKPLACES is already subdued, a transport or commuting shock is compressing discretionary trips, and retail-and-recreation mobility will decline within one week through reduced access and lower trip chaining.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to move lower within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -35 while WORKPLACES remains below -8.

candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM turns positive and stays above 0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 4-week average within 28 days after GROCERY_PHARM remains positive for two weeks.
